newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian shares seen consolidating recent gains.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian shares seen consolidating recent gains.

text.p: Hungarian share prices are expected to consolidate their recent gains on Friday, traders said.
"I expect a stagnant market, perhaps with mild gains," said Peter Nagy of Postabank Securities.
Nagy said the fact that Standard & Poor's (S&P) on Thursday affirmed Hungary's ratings but added that the ratings continue to be constrained by challenges, could cool the market's optimism somewhat.
"This is not a negative news in itself, but it certainly will not have any positive impact either," Nagy said.

S&P has affirmed Hungary's triple-'B'-minus long-term foreign currency rating and its single-'A'-minus local currency rating. At the same time, it has affirmed Hungary's 'A-1' short-term local currency rating and assigns its 'A-3' short-term foreign currency rating.
Attila Hunyadi of Buda-Cash Brokerhaz expected a quiet trade seeing only slight movements and modest turnover in leading stocks.
On Thursday the BUX index finished at a second successive closing high of 7,550.84 points, up 47.11.
